Two-channel colour key specification

Source: R/legend_2d.R
seq_legend_2d.Rd

Describes a smooth colour square over [0, 1] x [0, 1] for seq_tile_mix(), with channel a along x and channel b along y. Titles, tick positions and tick labels are supplied by the caller.

Usage

seq_legend_2d(
  color_a,
  color_b,
  x_title = NULL,
  y_title = NULL,
  x_breaks = c(0, 1),
  x_labels = NULL,
  y_breaks = c(0, 1),
  y_labels = NULL,
  note = NULL,
  size = 0.85,
  resolution = 128,
  position = c("canvas_margin", "track_margin", "inside"),
  side = "right",
  x = 0.08,
  y = 0.5
)

Arguments

color_a, color_b

Colours of the two channels.

x_title, y_title

Axis titles, or NULL.

x_breaks, y_breaks

Tick positions in [0, 1].

x_labels, y_labels

Tick labels. Default to the breaks.

note

Optional text drawn below the key.

size

Side length of the key in inches.

resolution

Number of raster cells per side.

position

One of "canvas_margin", "track_margin", "inside".

side

Margin side for margin positions.

x

Horizontal anchor as a fraction of the target width.

y

Vertical anchor of the key top as a fraction of the target height. In a canvas margin the key is placed below the other legend keys of the same side when they exist, and y is used otherwise.

Value

A SeqLegend2DSpec object.

Examples

seq_legend_2d("#D62728", "#2B59C3", x_title = "A", y_title = "B")
#> $color_a
#> [1] "#D62728"
#> 
#> $color_b
#> [1] "#2B59C3"
#> 
#> $x_title
#> [1] "A"
#> 
#> $y_title
#> [1] "B"
#> 
#> $x_breaks
#> [1] 0 1
#> 
#> $x_labels
#> [1] "0" "1"
#> 
#> $y_breaks
#> [1] 0 1
#> 
#> $y_labels
#> [1] "0" "1"
#> 
#> $note
#> NULL
#> 
#> $size
#> [1] 0.85
#> 
#> $resolution
#> [1] 128
#> 
#> $position
#> [1] "canvas_margin"
#> 
#> $side
#> [1] "right"
#> 
#> $x
#> [1] 0.08
#> 
#> $y
#> [1] 0.5
#> 
#> attr(,"class")
#> [1] "SeqLegend2DSpec"
